The same ' at' token does not fire it when it is the case-marked stimulus of a perception or attitude predicate ('look at', 'stare at', 'wink at', 'peer at', 'good at', 'amused at'); a weaker second component fires on a bare 'R' token at a word onset (initials such as 'R.L.' or 'Rhea', or 'the letter R'), where other capital initials are far weaker.
